queries.result: First-party discovery found the Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), its public Settlement map services, and the Ministry of Land's Land Zoning map portal. The Land Zoning portal was then inspected as a live public map/API service.

registryCustodian: Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys / Ministry of Land; the public map.land.gov.bd service exposes the Shariatpur district and Shariatpur Sadar administrative hierarchy.

registryEvidence.custodySummary: DLRS is the first-party land-record and survey authority. The Ministry of Land Land Zoning portal is a current public map service, not a private or third-party parcel source.
registryEvidence.localityEvidence: Public hierarchy calls returned Dhaka division code 30, Shariatpur district code 3086, Shariatpur Sadar upazila code 308669, and 104 Sadar mouzas.

sourceReview.service: Ministry of Land Land Zoning map portal (SMART BHUMI NAKSHA), backed by gis.land.gov.bd configuration
sourceReview.nativeFieldMapping: Bounded public response used fields gid, plot_no_en, label, m_code, jl_no_en, sht_no_en and geom (WKT). The viewer renders geom as EPSG:4326 and transforms it for display; no raw source attribute set was retained.
sourceReview.compositeKeyProvenance: The response exposes m_code plus plot_no_en and sheet/jurisdiction fields; this was observed but not promoted to a retained identity because stable-identity semantics were not independently documented.
sourceReview.crs: EPSG:4326 as declared in the official viewer's WKT read configuration; service CRS metadata was not separately verified.
